body: 2026-09-24. agx never refreshes a vendor login; an expired one is reported with the exact command that makes the vendor CLI refresh it. Why: refreshing rotates the refresh token, the vendor CLI's stored copy becomes invalid and the user is logged out. Consequence: a long-idle account shows 'expired' until used once. Narrowed by LOGINS_SPEC D5. See rule rul_01a147bb852171d080e52ed0d434f505.
title: AGX-002: credentials are read-only
